airlines.name: United Airlines
airlines.weight: No weight limit (pet must fit carrier)
airlines.trap: Roomy soft bag; long no-pet list (UK, Hawaii, Ireland…)

airlines.name: Delta Air Lines
airlines.trap: Easy domestic; no cabin pets to UK, Hawaii, Iceland…
airlines.species: Small dogs, cats and household birds (birds only within the contiguous U.S.)

airlines.name: American Airlines
airlines.weight: No general cabin limit (20 lb on A321T premium)
airlines.trap: Americas only: no carry-on pets transatlantic/transpacific

airlines.name: Air France
airlines.trap: Clear 8 kg rule; add pet ≥24 h ahead (48 h dogs to US)

airlines.name: Lufthansa
airlines.trap: Biggest bag (55×40×23); US dog bookings to 7 airports only

airlines.name: Air Canada
airlines.trap: Lowest cabin fee; only 20 cm height on mainline
airlines.species: Cats and small dogs (one per passenger, at least 10 weeks old)

airlines.name: Alaska Airlines
airlines.trap: Cheap & clear; low 9.5 in carrier height

airlines.name: Hawaiian Airlines
airlines.trap: Shares Alaska rules; Hawaii quarantine rules apply
airlines.species: Small dogs and house cats (also domesticated rabbits and small household birds on some routes; only dogs, cats and rabbits in the cabin to Hawaii, rabbits to Honolulu only)

airlines.name: JetBlue
airlines.fee: Not shown on the page we fetched
airlines.trap: Soft or hard carrier OK; no Mint, exit or bulkhead

airlines.name: Southwest Airlines
airlines.trap: US only: no international, no Hawaii (except inter-island)
airlines.species: Small vaccinated domestic cats and dogs (at least 8 weeks old)

airlines.name: British Airways
airlines.hold: Hold only, via PetAir UK / IAG Cargo
airlines.trap: No pets in the cabin on any route
airlines.species: None (no pets in the cabin on any route)

hotels.name: Kimpton (IHG)
hotels.species: Any pet that "fits through the door" (furry, feathery or scaly)
hotels.notes: Brand-wide promise on Kimpton's pet page; individual hotels may still post their own rules, so check the hotel page.

hotels.name: Motel 6
hotels.notes: Pets must be declared at check-in and not left alone in the room. Some Studio 6 properties may charge a pet fee; local law can forbid pets at a location.

hotels.name: Red Roof Inn / Red Roof PLUS+
hotels.fee: 1st pet free; 2nd pet $15 per night (max $105 per extra pet for 7+ nights)
hotels.pets: 2 per room (more at manager's discretion, $15/night each)
hotels.notes: HomeTowne Studios and The Red Collection set their own rules. Two listed locations (Oxon Hill, MD and Bellmawr, NJ) cannot accept pets.

hotels.name: La Quinta by Wyndham
hotels.fee: Optional fee up to $25 per night, max $75 per room per stay
hotels.weight: Some locations set a limit (ask the hotel)
hotels.species: Domestic pets such as dogs and cats
hotels.notes: Pets are not allowed in the breakfast area, gym or pool. La Quinta lists hotels that take no pets, including La Quinta New York City Central Park, Queens, Brooklyn Downtown and Brooklyn East.

hotels.name: Drury Hotels
hotels.fee: Daily fee, minimum $50 per night (varies by hotel)
hotels.notes: Pets are not allowed in the lobby, dining area, pool or fitness center and should not be left alone in the room.

hotels.name: Loews Hotels
hotels.notes: Up-to-date vaccinations required. Loews says additional cleaning fees and property-specific policies may apply: check the hotel's page.

hotels.name: Hilton brands (Hampton, Home2, Homewood, DoubleTree, Embassy Suites and more)
hotels.fee: Fees apply and vary by hotel
hotels.notes: Hilton says it welcomes pets at over 5,000 hotels in the US and Canada; rules are set per hotel, so filter for pet-friendly and read the hotel's policy.

hotels.name: Aloft (Marriott)
hotels.notes: Aloft's ARF program welcomes pets with a bed, bowl, treats and toys. The brand page gives no fee, weight or number: each Marriott hotel sets its own pet rules.

hotels.name: Four Seasons
hotels.notes: No brand-wide pet policy: each hotel sets its own. Example: Four Seasons Hotel New York Downtown welcomes dogs and cats under 25 lb.

hotels.name: Best Western
hotels.notes: We could not load Best Western's official pet-friendly page on the date checked, so we show no numbers. Check the hotel's own page before you book.
